text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nine hundred ninety-eight! Nine
hundred
ninety-nine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh! HNNNNNGH! GYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The intensity of today's training is
completely off
the charts, and it's all
because of a conversation
that got a
little bit out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It started when Bamboo Memory and I
got
sidetracked during a meeting about
her training
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way! You've seen that show too? I
watched it
with my dad!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then you gotta know this line!
"Throw
everything you got at me! I'll
train until my sweat
runs dry!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it! Man, their
back-and-forths during
the training
scenes were always so fiery!
choice_data_list: "Your sweat may dry, but never your spirit... Charge!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a second! I just had a great
idea! Why
don't we try doing the same
thing during our
training sessions?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We can pretend we're actually the
characters in
the show to really liven
things up! I'll be the
disciple, of course!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I bet it'll be awesome! Can we
give it a
shot? Pleeeaaase?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to make an
extra-intense
training regimen where we
keep motivation high
by throwing
passionate lines back and forth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, we've reached the final
exercise for the
day—shuttle runs from
hell!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
GRAAAAAH! HNNNNNGH! Th-this is
rough!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
N-no! Th-that's right! I... I swore I'd win! I
made a
vow back in that valley!
choice_data_list: 'You'll never defeat them at this rate!'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH! Don't fail me now, muscles!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze! I did it! I finished all the exercises!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way! That can't be it! I'm not ready to
stop!
choice_data_list: 'And with this, your training is complete.'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't you remember? In the show, the
main
character kept training until they
collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So that's what I've got to do too! No, that's not enough... I have to train even harder than that if I want to be like the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Trainer! This is where our story
starts!
One that goes above and beyond
the show!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is appreciated, but she
might
exhaust herself if she keeps
going... Hm, what to
do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is appreciated, but she
might
exhaust herself if she keeps
going... Hm, what to
do?
choice_data_list: ...Go forth and do so! Follow your heart's desire!
A post-training meal scene was a staple, wasn't it?
Eating scenes after training were a classic trope, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let's put our heads
together and
come up with an even
tougher regimen than the
one in the
show!
choice_data_list: ...Go forth and do so! Follow your heart's desire!
A post-training meal scene was a staple, wasn't it?
Eating scenes after training were a classic trope, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we put together repeating
sets of
sprints, bunny hops, leg lifts, and
cossack squats,
followed by a run on the
longest route around the
neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It still isn't enough for Bamboo Memory,
though.
After some fervent begging, I
end up sitting on a
tire for her to pull
behind her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, now we're literally in this
together! As
long as you keep shouting
encouragement at me,
there's no way I'll
fail!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! With our powers
combined, we
can do ANYTHING!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Let's go! Let's GOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! My limits don't EXIIIIIST!
choice_data_list: Go, Bamboo!! Run red-hot and full throttle!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Incredibly enough, Bamboo Memory
finishes the
training set before sunset on
burning passion
alone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant! I couldn't have kept this up without your nonstop encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That seriously felt like we had our own
training
montage in a show starring the
two of us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks even more chipper than
before we
started. It seems blasting past
her limits helped
her make vast
improvements!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Let's go! Let's GOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Grrr... Lets... gooooo!
choice_data_list: Go for it, Bamboo! You've got this!
Go for it, Bamboo! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I-I made it! I thought... I was gonna die...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is completely out of
breath, but
she still managed to
overcome this incredible test
of
endurance!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Let's go! Let's GOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory tries to tough it out,
but it
seems like she was already at her
limit before we
started...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Mngh! M-my soul's... burning... out...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was so close too! Urgh... Darn it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, she isn't able to finish the

regimen... Bamboo Memory is so
exhausted, she
stumbles the whole way
back to campus.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! That show's also famous
for all
the great food scenes! Everything
always looked
so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Remember the time they chowed down a
huge
mountain of freshly-picked
carrots?! Oh, and
there was always
enough fried rice to feed an
army!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about it is making me
hungry! Let
me go change real quick,
and then let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That hit the spot! Thinking back on all
those food
scenes got me so fired up, I
couldn't stop eating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing like a delicious meal
after a good
workout. Thoroughly
nourished, Bamboo Memory
looks
refreshed and energized.
